      "content": "# @240xu/dsh-websearch\n\n[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@240xu/dsh-websearch.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@240xu/dsh-websearch)\n[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)\n\n> Aggregated web search provider for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) — one plugin id `unified` that fans out to eleven backends concurrently, merges + URL-dedups results, and stays usable even when some backends go down.\n\nA pure-Cordis drop-in: registers ONE provider at `ctx.web` so the `dsh-web` selection rule never fires `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`. Zero-config search out of the box (Exa + Parallel + DuckDuckGo + SearXNG are keyless); API-key backends (DeepSeek / Anthropic / OpenAI / Brave / Tavily / Serper / Mojeek) auto-activate once their key is supplied via the credentials service or env.\n\n---\n\nDSH（[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)）原生插件：向 `ctx.web` 注册**唯一**的聚合搜索 provider `unified`，内置十一后端并发 fan-out，合并 + URL 去重后返回——即使部分后端宕机仍可用。\n\n纯 Cordis 直插：只注册一个 provider，所以 `dsh-web` 的选择规则永远不会触发 `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`。**零配置即可搜索**——Exa + Parallel + DuckDuckGo + SearXNG 四者皆无 key、开箱即用；DeepSeek / Anthropic / OpenAI / Brave / Tavily / Serper / Mojeek 在提供 API key 后自动激活。\n\n## Backends | 后端\n\n| id | key | endpoint | how it returns | notes |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| `exa` | none | `https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp` | streamable-http MCP, tool `web_search_exa { query, numResults }`, text blocks \"Title:/URL:/Published:/Highlights:\" | opencode 同源,无 key |\n| `parallel` | none | `https://search.parallel.ai/mcp` | streamable-http MCP, tool `web_search { objective, search_queries[], session_id?, model_name? }` returns JSON-string `{ search_id, results: [{ url, title, publish_date, excerpts[] }] }` | opencode 同源,无 key |\n| `ddg` | none | `https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/` | HTML scrape, decode `uddg=` redirect param for real URL + `result__snippet` | 兜底,零依赖 |\n| `searxng` | none/optional | `https://searx.be/search` (default) | REST JSON `/search?q=`, public instances unlimited | 元搜索,隐私友好 |\n| `brave` | `BRAVE_API_KEY` | `https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search` | REST JSON, independent index, 2000/mo free | 高质量,无 Google 偏见 |\n| `tavily` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | `https://api.tavily.com/search` | REST JSON, AI-focused, `answer` + `results[]`, deep search | AI 专用,含答案摘要 |\n| []) {\n    if (!s || typeof s.url !== \"string\" || s.url.length === 0) continue;\n    const key = s.url.toLowerCase();\n    const existing = byUrl.get(key);\n    if (existing) {\n      if (!existing.title && s.title) existing.title = s.title;\n      if (!existing.snippet && s.snippet) existing.snippet = s.snippet;\n      if (!existing.publishedAt && s.publishedAt) existing.publishedAt = s.publishedAt;\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    if (strategy === \"url+title\" && typeof s.title === \"string\" && s.title.length > 0) {\n      const tokens = tokenize(s.title);\n      const dupOf = keptTitles.find((k) => tokenSimilarity(k.tokens, tokens) >= TITLE_DUP_THRESHOLD);\n      if (dupOf) {\n        // Same story from another outlet: enrich the kept entry with any\n        // fields the mirror carries and the original lacks.\n        if (!dupOf.source.title && s.title) dupOf.source.title = s.title;\n        if (!dupOf.source.snippet && s.snippet) dupOf.source.snippet = s.snippet;\n        if (!dupOf.source.publishedAt && s.publishedAt) dupOf.source.publishedAt = s.publishedAt;\n        continue;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const copy = { ...s };\n    byUrl.set(key, copy);\n    out.push(copy);\n    if (strategy === \"url+title\" && typeof s.title === \"string\" && s.title.length > 0) {\n      // backfill this kept entry into its title bucket for later comparisons\n      keptTitles.push({ tokens: tokenize(s.title), source: copy });\n    }\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\n/**\n * Score one source against the query tokens:\n *   title match ×3, snippet match ×2, URL match ×1.\n */\nfunction scoreSource(source, queryTokens) {\n  let score = 0;\n  const titleTokens = tokenize(source.title ?? \"\");\n  const snippetTokens = tokenize(source.snippet ?? \"\");\n  const urlTokens = tokenize(String(source.url ?? \"\"));\n  for (const q of queryTokens) {\n    if (titleTokens.has(q)) score += 3;\n    if (snippetTokens.has(q)) score += 2;\n    if (urlTokens.has(q)) score += 1;\n  }\n  return score;\n}\n\n/**\n * Deterministic relevance rerank.       "content": "// rrf.js — v2.8.0 Reciprocal Rank Fusion (pure functions, zero deps).\n//\n// RRF merges multiple ranked result lists into one: each list contributes\n// score 1/(k + rank) to every item it contains (k=60 is the canonical value\n// from Cormack et al. 2009, popularized by RAG-Fusion\n// https://github.com/Raudaschl/rag-fusion). Items are deduped by URL; the\n// first-seen entry wins for metadata, scores accumulate across lists.\n//\n// Why RRF over naive concatenation: it needs no score calibration across\n// backends/queries (only ranks), and demotes one-off hits while promoting\n// items that appear in several lists.\n\n/** Canonical RRF constant. */\nexport const RRF_K = 60;\n\n/** Stable key for dedupe (URL string; missing/odd URLs fall back to title). */\nfunction itemKey(item) {\n  if (item && typeof item.url === \"string\" && item.url.length > 0) return item.url;\n  if (item && typeof item.title === \"string\") return `t:${item.title}`;\n  return \"\";\n}\n\n/**\n * Fuse ranked lists of search sources with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.\n *\n * @param {Array<Array<object>>} lists  each list is already ranked best-first\n * @param {{k?: number}} [opts]         k constant (default 60)\n * @returns {{ fused: object[], scores: Map<string, number> }}\n *   fused: sources sorted by accumulated RRF score desc (ties keep first\n *   appearance order); sources without a usable key are dropped.\n */\nexport function rrfFuse(lists, { k = RRF_K } = {}) {\n  const kk = Number(k) > 0 ? Number(k) : RRF_K;\n  const scores = new Map(); // key -> accumulated score\n  const firstSeen = new Map(); // key -> source object (first metadata wins)\n  const order = []; // keys in first-appearance order (stable ties)\n\n  for (const list of Array.isArray(lists) ? lists : []) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue;\n    for (let rank = 0; rank < list.length; rank++) {\n      const item = list[rank];\n      const key = itemKey(item);\n      if (!key) continue;\n      scores.set(key, (scores.get(key) ?? 0) + 1 / (kk + rank));\n      if (!firstSeen.has(key)) {\n        firstSeen.set(key, item);\n        order.push(key);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const fused = [...order]\n    .sort((a, b) => (scores.get(b) ?? 0) - (scores.get(a) ?? 0))\n    .map((key) => firstSeen.get(key));\n  return { fused, scores };\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * SearXNG backend for dsh-websearch.\n * REST API: {baseURL}/search?q={query}&format=json&categories=general&language=en&safesearch=1\n * Auth: None (public instances) or API key for private instances\n * Free tier: Unlimited (public instances)\n * Default instance: https://searx.be\n *\n * Health is SEMANTIC (route3/route6): HTTP 200 alone means nothing — public\n * instances answer non-browser clients with anti-bot interstitials (searx.be\n * served an 11 KB \"Verifying your browser…\" page with status 200). Used only to CLASSIFY a non-JSON 200 for telemetry/health —\n// there is deliberately no evasion logic here (no JS, no cookie forging).\nconst ANTI_BOT_RE = /(verifying your browser|making sure you.?re not a bot|checking you are not a bot|anubis|antibot|security check|just a moment|enable javascript|captcha|browser verification)/i;\n\n// Multi-instance failover (opt-in via searxngBaseURLs; route3 §5.4 draft).\n// Public-instance 429/anti-bot windows run 5-8+ minutes, so a failed instance\n// is rotated out (not retried every search); a success clears its cooldown.\n// Fail-open: when every candidate is cooling down we still try them all —\n// rotation must never make search worse than the single-instance status quo.\nconst INSTANCE_COOLDOWN_MS = 10 * 60_000;\nconst INSTANCE_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;\nconst instanceCooldowns = new Map(); // baseURL -> cooledUntil (epoch ms)\n\n/** Test hook: clear per-instance cooldowns between cases. */\nexport function resetInstanceCooldowns() {\n  instanceCooldowns.clear();\n}\n\n/** @type {import(\"../provider.js\").Backend} */\nexport const searxngBackend = {\n  id: \"searxng\",\n  requiresCredential: false,\n\n  available(options) {\n    // Keyless by default, but can use API key for private instances\n    return true;\n  },\n\n  async search(request, signal, options, hooks) {\n    throwIfSearchAborted(signal);\n    const backendOpts = options ?? {};\n    const baseURL = backendOpts.baseURL ?? DEFAULT_SEARXNG_URL;\n    const apiKey = await backendOpts.resolveApiKey?.(); // Optional for private instances\n\n    const candidates = [];\n    for (const candidate of [baseURL, ...(Array.isArray(backendOpts.baseURLs) ? backendOpts.baseURLs : [])]) {\n      const trimmed = typeof candidate === \"string\" ? candidate.trim() : \"\";\n      if (trimmed !== \"\" && !candidates.includes(trimmed)) candidates.push(trimmed);\n    }\n\n    // Single instance (the default): legacy path, unchanged semantics.\n    if (candidates.length === 1) {\n      const sources = await queryInstance(candidates[0], request, signal, backendOpts, apiKey, hooks);\n      return { sources };\n    }\n\n    // Multi-instance: sequential attempts (etiquette: never fan out against\n    // volunteer instances), per-instance soft timeout, cooldown on failure.\n    const now = Date.now();\n    const fresh = candidates.filter((u) => (instanceCooldowns.get(u) ?? 0) <= now);\n    const order = fresh.length > 0 ? fresh : candidates; // all cooled -> fail-open\n    let lastErr = null;\n    for (const candidate of order) {\n      throwIfSearchAborted(signal);\n      const attemptController = new AbortController();\n      const attemptSignal = signal ? Throws WebError on any failure; abort\n * semantics are the caller's contract (signal passed through verbatim).\n * @returns {Promise<Array>} sources\n */\nasync function queryInstance(baseURL, request, signal, backendOpts, apiKey, hooks) {\n  const url = new URL(baseURL);\n  url.pathname = url.pathname.replace(/\\/+$/,\"\") + \"/search\";\n  url.searchParams.set(\"q\", request.query);\n  url.searchParams.set(\"format\", \"json\");\n  // deepCoverage widens the category sweep (docs.searxng.org Search API:\n  // categories is a comma-separated list) — breadth over one category.\n  url.searchParams.set(\"categories\", request.deepCoverage === true ? \"general,news,it\" : \"general\");\n  // Language: settings/request filter wins, else historical \"en\" default.\n  const filters = normalizeFilters(request.filters);\n  url.searchParams.set(\"language\", filters.lang ?? \"en\");\n  applySearxngFilters(url, filters); // time_range (+ language override)\n  // Safe-search defaults ON (preserves the previous hardcoded behavior).\n  url.searchParams.set(\"safesearch\", safeSearchParams(\"searxng\", backendOpts.safeSearch ?? true) ?? \"1\");\n  url.searchParams.set(\"pageno\", \"1\");\n\n  const headers = {\n    \"Accept\": \"application/json\",\n    \"User-Agent\": \"dsh-websearch/2.3\",\n  };\n  if (apiKey) {\n    headers[\"Authorization\"] = \"Bearer \" + apiKey;\n  }\n\n  hooks?.recordRequest?.({\n    endpoint: baseURL,\n    toolName: \"searxng_search\",\n    body: { q: request.query },\n  });\n\n  let response;\n  try {\n    response = await egressFetch(url, {\n      method: \"GET\",\n      headers,\n      redirect: \"error\",\n      signal,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (signal?.aborted === true || isAbortError(error)) throw searchAborted(signal, error);\n    throw new WebError(\"SearXNG request failed: \" + describeError(error) +\n      \" (instance unreachable? point searxngBaseURL at another public instance)\", \"WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR\");\n    }\n    throw new WebError(\"SearXNG API error (HTTP \" + response.status + \"): \" + text, \"WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR\");\n  }\n\n  // 200 does not mean JSON (route3: searx.be 200 + HTML anti-bot page). [];\n  \n  for (const item of results) {\n    if (sources.length >= maxResults) break;\n    if (!item?.url) continue;\n    sources.push({\n      url: item.url,\n      ...(item.title ? { title: item.title } : {}),\n      ...(item.content ? { snippet: item.content.slice(0, 500) } : {}),\n      ...(item.engine ? { sourceEngine: item.engine } : {}),\n    });\n  }\n  \n  return sources;\n}\n"
